exceptions.rationale: Only printpdf 0.8.2 depends on this version. Production renders PDFs; imported PDFs go through pdf-extract 0.12.1/lopdf 0.42.0. PdfDocument::parse calls occur only in tests reading generated synthetic output. Keep renderer/layout stable; reassess if any input path calls printpdf PDF parsing. This exception does not approve arbitrary PDF parsing with 0.35.

Production never calls ZipArchive::extract or ZipStreamReader::extract. archive.rs validates paths, rejects symlinks/special entries, validates declared size/ratio/count and streams with a hard output cap into private staging. No archive permissions are applied. Keep supported compression formats; revisit if an extract API is introduced.

Build-only phf_generator 0.8 dependency; no custom logger recursively calling thread_rng. No application use of this rand version. A PHF/HTML renderer major migration would change unrelated rendering dependencies. Revisit logger/build graph changes.
